title: A1 yakuniy imtihon
goal_uz: Dars oxirida butun A1 darajani takrorlaysiz: to be va hozirgi oddiy zamondan imtihon topshiriqlarida foydalanasiz, asosiy so‘zlar va muloqot iboralarini eslaysiz, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish vazifalarini vaqt bilan bajarasiz.

scenes.title: A1 yakuniy imtihoni
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Birinchi bosqichning oxirgi darsiga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda oddiy matnni o‘qish va tinglashni mashq qildik. Bugun butun A1 darajani takrorlaymiz: grammatika, so‘zlar, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish. Har bir bo‘limda vaqtli mashq bo‘ladi, oxirida esa o‘n besh savolli test. Dars oxirida o‘zingizni imtihonga tayyor sezasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to the last lesson of level A1. Today we review everything and practise for the exam.
scenes.say_uz: A1 darajasining oxirgi darsiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun hamma narsani takrorlaymiz va imtihonga tayyorlanamiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon qanday tuzilgan?
scenes.say_native: A1 imtihon odatda oltita qismdan iborat: grammatika, lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish. Biz bugun xuddi shu tartibda ishlaymiz. Har bir qismda vazifa turini ko‘rasiz, vaqt bilan bajarasiz va javobini tekshirasiz. Bu darsdagi vaqt chegaralari mashq uchun mo‘ljallangan. Haqiqiy imtihon qoidalarini esa imtihon beruvchidan aniqlab oling.
scenes.say: The exam has six parts: grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, writing and speaking.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon oltita qismdan iborat: grammatika, lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish.

scenes.title: Imtihon strategiyasi
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta qoida. Birinchi: topshiriqni diqqat bilan o‘qing, ko‘pchilik xatolar noto‘g‘ri tushunishdan kelib chiqadi. Ikkinchi: oson savollardan boshlang, qiyinini keyinga qoldiring. Uchinchi: hech qaysi savolni bo‘sh qoldirmang, taxmin qilish bo‘sh qoldirishdan yaxshi. To‘rtinchi: oxirida vaqt qolsa, javoblarni tekshiring, ayniqsa fe’lning s harfi va bosh harflarni.
scenes.say: Read the instruction. Do the easy questions first. Never leave a blank. Check your answers.
scenes.say_uz: Topshiriqni o‘qing. Avval oson savollarni bajaring. Hech narsani bo‘sh qoldirmang. Javoblarni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Grammatika 1: to be
board: I am / you are / he, she, it is
I am not / She isn't / Are you...?
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz: to be fe’li. I am, you are, he is, she is, it is, we are, you are, they are. Inkor uchun not qo‘shamiz: She is not yoki she isn’t. Savolda fe’l gap boshiga chiqadi: Are you a student? Is he at home? O‘zbek tilida “men talabaman” deymiz, “bor” fe’li kerak emas. Inglizchada esa to be har doim kerak, hech qachon tushirib qoldirmang.
scenes.say: I am a student. She is at home. Are you from Tashkent?
scenes.say_uz: Men talabaman. U uyda. Siz Toshkentdansizmi?

scenes.title: To be xatolari
board: ✗ She not is here → ✓ She is not here
✗ Where you from? → ✓ Where are you from?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilarning uchta mashhur xatosi. Birinchi: yoshni “I have 25 years” deb aytish. To‘g‘risi: I am twenty-five. Ikkinchi: inkorda tartibni buzish, “She not is”. To‘g‘risi: She is not. Uchinchi: savolda to be ni unutish, “Where you from?” Ingliz tilida: Where are you from? Bu uch xatoni tuzatish imtihonda ko‘p ball beradi.
scenes.say: I am twenty-five. She is not here. Where are you from?
scenes.say_uz: Men yigirma beshdaman. U bu yerda emas. Siz qayerdansiz?

scenes.title: Grammatika mashqi 1
scenes.say_native: Vaqtli mashq: yigirma soniya. Beshta bo‘sh joyni to‘ldiring: am, is yoki are. Birinchi: akam shifokor. Ikkinchi: biz O‘zbekistondanmiz. Uchinchi: men yigirma besh yoshdaman. To‘rtinchi: siz talabamisiz? Beshinchi: ular uyda emas. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: One. My brother blank a doctor. Two. We blank from Uzbekistan. Three. I blank twenty-five years old. Four. Blank you a student? Five. They blank not at home.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Akam shifokor. Ikki. Biz O‘zbekistondanmiz. Uch. Men yigirma besh yoshdaman. To‘rt. Siz talabamisiz? Besh. Ular uyda emas.

scenes.title: Javoblar: grammatika 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — is, chunki my brother bitta odam, he. Ikkinchi — are, we bilan. Uchinchi — am, faqat I bilan. To‘rtinchi — Are you a student, savolda fe’l boshda. Beshinchi — are, they bilan. Beshta to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, to be to‘liq o‘zlashtirilgan. Xato bo‘lsa, yuqoridagi jadvalni yana bir ko‘rib chiqing.
scenes.say: One, is. Two, are. Three, am. Four, are. Five, are.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, is. Ikki, are. Uch, am. To‘rt, are. Besh, are.

scenes.title: Grammatika 2: Present Simple
scenes.say_native: Endi hozirgi oddiy zamon. Odatiy ishlar haqida gapirishda ishlatiladi. I, you, we, they bilan fe’l o‘zgarmaydi: I work. He, she, it bilan s qo‘shiladi: she works. Savolda do yoki does, inkorda don’t yoki doesn’t. Muhim: does yoki doesn’t bo‘lsa, fe’lga s qo‘shilmaydi, chunki s allaqachon does ichida. Does she work? She doesn’t work.
scenes.say: I work in a bank. She works in a shop. Does he work here?
scenes.say_uz: Men bankda ishlayman. U do‘konda ishlaydi. U shu yerda ishlaydimi?

scenes.title: Present Simple xatolari
board: ✗ She work in a bank → ✓ She works
✗ Does she works? → ✓ Does she work?
✗ He don't like tea → ✓ He doesn't like tea
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: she bilan s ni unutish, “She work”. To‘g‘risi — she works. Ikkinchisi: does bilan yana s qo‘shish, “Does she works”. To‘g‘risi — does she work. Uchinchisi: he bilan don’t, “He don’t like”. To‘g‘risi — he doesn’t like. O‘zbekchada fe’l shaxs bilan o‘zgaradi, lekin bu yerda faqat uchinchi shaxsda s bor. Buni imtihonda tekshiring.
scenes.say: She works in a bank. Does she work? He doesn't like tea.
scenes.say_uz: U bankda ishlaydi. U ishlaydimi? U choyni yoqtirmaydi.

scenes.title: Grammatika mashqi 2
scenes.say_native: Yigirma soniya. Birinchi: u bankda ishlaydi, work fe’lini to‘g‘ri shaklda qo‘ying. Ikkinchi: siz choyni yoqtirasizmi, do yoki does? Uchinchi: u kofe ichmaydi. To‘rtinchi: ota-onam Toshkentda yashaydi. Beshinchi: u inglizcha gapiradimi, do yoki does? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: One. She blank, work, in a bank. Two. Blank you like tea? Three. He doesn't blank coffee. Four. My parents blank in Tashkent. Five. Blank she speak English?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. U bankda ishlaydi. Ikki. Siz choyni yoqtirasizmi? Uch. U kofe ichmaydi. To‘rt. Ota-onam Toshkentda yashaydi. Besh. U inglizcha gapiradimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: grammatika 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — works, she bilan s. Ikkinchi — Do you like tea, you bilan do. Uchinchi — doesn’t drink, asosiy fe’l oddiy shaklda. To‘rtinchi — live, my parents ya’ni they. Beshinchi — Does she speak, she bilan does. Agar uchtadan kam xato qilgan bo‘lsangiz, bu bo‘lim bo‘yicha yaxshi tayyorsiz.
scenes.say: Works. Do. Drink. Live. Does.
scenes.say_uz: Works. Do. Drink. Live. Does.

scenes.title: Grammatika 3: tezkor takrorlash
board: There is a... / There are two...
I can swim. / Can you swim?

examples.t: This is my bag. These are my keys.
examples.uz: Bu mening sumkam. Bular mening kalitlarim.

scenes.say_native: Yana bir nechta qoida. Artikl: undosh tovushdan oldin a, unlidan oldin an: a book, an apple. Ko‘plik: odatda s, lekin box — boxes, child — children. There is bitta narsa uchun, there are ko‘p uchun. Can dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda: I can swim. This — bitta yaqin narsa, ko‘plikda these. Hammasini quyida mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say: There is a book. There are two apples. I can swim.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta kitob bor. Ikkita olma bor. Men suza olaman.

scenes.title: Tez-tez uchraydigan xatolar
board: ✗ I can to swim → ✓ I can swim
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: can dan keyin to qo‘yish, “I can to swim”. To‘g‘risi: I can swim. Ikkinchisi: a apple, chunki apple unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an apple. Uchinchisi: sondan keyin birlik shakli, two book. O‘zbek tilida son bilan ko‘plik kerak emas: ikkita kitob, shuning uchun inglizchada ham tushib qolishi mumkin. Inglizchada s shart.
scenes.say: I can swim. An apple. Two books.
scenes.say_uz: Men suza olaman. Bitta olma. Ikkita kitob.

scenes.title: Grammatika mashqi 3
board: 1) There ___ two chairs in the room.
4) Look at my keys. ___ are my keys.
scenes.say_native: Yigirma soniya. Birinchi: xonada ikkita stul bor, is yoki are? Ikkinchi: men inglizcha gapira olaman. Uchinchi: uning apelsini bor, a yoki an? To‘rtinchi: mening kalitlarim, this yoki these? Beshinchi: bitta quti, ikkita quti. Har biriga javob bering.
scenes.say: One. There blank two chairs in the room. Two. I can blank English. Three. She has blank orange. Four. Blank are my keys. Five. One box, two blank.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Xonada ikkita stul bor. Ikki. Men inglizcha gapira olaman. Uch. Uning apelsini bor. To‘rt. Bular mening kalitlarim. Besh. Bitta quti, ikkita quti.

scenes.title: Javoblar: grammatika 3
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — are, chunki two chairs ko‘plik. Ikkinchi — speak, can dan keyin to yo‘q. Uchinchi — an orange, chunki orange unli bilan boshlanadi. To‘rtinchi — These are my keys, kalitlar ko‘p. Beshinchi — boxes, x bilan tugagan so‘zga es qo‘shiladi. Beshta to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, grammatika qismi tayyor.
scenes.say: Are. Speak. An. These. Boxes.
scenes.say_uz: Are. Speak. An. These. Boxes.

scenes.title: Lug‘at: shaxs, oila va ovqat
scenes.say_native: Endi lug‘at. Birinchi guruh: oila va kasblar. Mother, father, brother, sister, parents. Teacher, doctor, student, driver. Ikkinchi guruh: ovqat va ichimlik. Bread, rice, milk, tea, coffee, fruit, vegetables. Imtihonda ko‘pincha so‘zni guruhga ajratish yoki rasmga moslash vazifasi bo‘ladi, shuning uchun so‘zlarni mavzu bo‘yicha o‘rganing, alifbo bo‘yicha emas.
scenes.say: My mother is a teacher. I like rice and fruit.
scenes.say_uz: Onam o‘qituvchi. Men guruch va mevani yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: Lug‘at: shahar, vaqt va kunlar
board: town: bank, shop, library, post office

examples.t: The library is open on Friday.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi to‘plam: shahar va vaqt. Bank, shop, library, post office, station, market. Kunlar: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Oylar ham muhim: January, February, March va hokazo. Hamma kun va oy nomi bosh harf bilan yoziladi. Bu o‘zbek tilidan farq qiladi, imtihonda yozma qismda shu yerda ball yo‘qotmang.
scenes.say: The bank is open on Monday. My birthday is in March.
scenes.say_uz: Bank dushanba kuni ochiq. Mening tug‘ilgan kunim martda.

scenes.title: Lug‘at mashqi: ortiqcha so‘z
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir qatorda ortiqcha so‘zni toping. Birinchi: bus, train, apple, taxi. Ikkinchi: mother, brother, teacher, sister. Uchinchi: Monday, Friday, July, Sunday. To‘rtinchi: bread, milk, shirt, rice. Nega bu so‘z ortiqcha, tushuntirib bering.
scenes.say: Find the odd one out. One. Bus, train, apple, taxi. Two. Mother, brother, teacher, sister. Three. Monday, Friday, July, Sunday. Four. Bread, milk, shirt, rice.
scenes.say_uz: Ortiqcha so‘zni toping. Bir. Bus, train, apple, taxi. Ikki. Mother, brother, teacher, sister. Uch. Monday, Friday, July, Sunday. To‘rt. Bread, milk, shirt, rice.

scenes.title: Javoblar: lug‘at
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — apple, qolganlari transport. Ikkinchi — teacher, qolganlari oila a’zolari. Uchinchi — July, bu oy, qolganlari hafta kunlari. To‘rtinchi — shirt, bu kiyim, qolganlari ovqat. Mavzu bo‘yicha o‘ylash yo‘li to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ushbu vazifa turi sizga yengil bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Apple. Teacher. July. Shirt.
scenes.say_uz: Apple. Teacher. July. Shirt.

scenes.title: Tanishuv: nimalarni bilish kerak
board: How old are you? I'm ... years old.
What do you do? I'm a student.
scenes.say_native: Tanishuv iboralari. My name is Dilya. I’m from Samarkand. How old are you? I’m twenty-four. Nice to meet you. Kasb haqida: What do you do? I’m a student yoki I work in a bank. Yoshni so‘rashda faqat to be ishlatiladi, “have” emas. Savollarga to‘liq, lekin qisqa javob bering va qaytarib so‘rang: And you?
scenes.say: My name is Dilya. I'm from Samarkand. Nice to meet you.
scenes.say_uz: Mening ismim Dilya. Men Samarqanddanman. Tanishganimdan xursandman.

scenes.title: Do‘konda: nimalarni bilish kerak
board: Do you have it in a large?
scenes.say_native: Do‘kon iboralari. How much is this? Yoki ko‘plikda: How much are these? Can I have a coffee, please? I’d like a blue shirt, please. O‘lcham: Do you have it in a large? To‘lov: Can I pay by card? Cash or card? Narx: it’s five pounds, ular esa five pounds ham. Oldingi darsda o‘rganganimiz kabi, please va thank you doim kerak.
scenes.say: How much is this? Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_uz: Bu qancha turadi? Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Yo‘l ko‘rsatish: nimalarni bilish kerak
board: It's on the left / on the right.
Is it far? It's five minutes on foot.
scenes.say_native: Yo‘l so‘rash va ko‘rsatish. Excuse me, where is the bank? Go straight. Turn left at the shop. Turn right at the bridge. It’s next to the post office, opposite the library, between the café and the bank. On the left, on the right. Is it far? It’s five minutes on foot. Bu so‘zlar oldingi darslarning asosiy qismi.
scenes.say: Go straight and turn left. It's next to the bank.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri yuring va chapga buriling. U bankning yonida.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: do‘konda
scenes.say_native: Tinglash qismi. Birinchi dialog do‘konda bo‘lib o‘tadi. Mijoz ko‘ylak sotib olmoqchi. Siz narxni, rangni, o‘lchamni va to‘lov usulini topishingiz kerak. Bir marta tinglang, so‘ng savollarga javob bering. Imtihonda ham ko‘pincha dialogni ikki marta eshittirishadi, ammo bu yerda diqqat bilan eshiting.
scenes.say: Hello. Can I help you? Yes. How much is this blue T-shirt? It's twelve pounds. Do you have it in a large? Yes, here you are. Thanks. Can I pay by card? Yes, of course.
scenes.say_uz: Salom. Yordam bera olamanmi? Ha. Bu ko‘k futbolka qancha turadi? O‘n ikki funt. Sizda bu katta o‘lchamda bormi? Ha, marhamat. Rahmat. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Ha, albatta.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: savollar
board: 3) What size does the customer want?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: futbolka qanday rangda? Ikkinchi: u qancha turadi? Uchinchi: mijoz qaysi o‘lchamni so‘radi? To‘rtinchi: u qanday to‘laydi? Qisqa javoblar yetarli, masalan “Blue”. Dialogni yodingizdan tiklang.
scenes.say: One. What colour is the T-shirt? Two. How much is it? Three. What size does the customer want? Four. How does the customer pay?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Futbolka qanday rangda? Ikki. U qancha turadi? Uch. Mijoz qaysi o‘lchamni xohlaydi? To‘rt. U qanday to‘laydi?

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Rang — blue, ko‘k. Narx — twelve pounds, o‘n ikki funt. O‘lcham — a large, katta. To‘lov — by card, karta bilan. Imtihon strategiyasi: savollarni oldindan o‘qib qo‘ysangiz, tinglayotganda aynan shu ma’lumotlarni qidirasiz. Raqamlar va ranglarga e’tibor bering, ular odatda javob bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Blue. Twelve pounds. A large. By card.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘k. O‘n ikki funt. Katta. Karta bilan.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: yo‘l so‘rash
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog ko‘chada. Sayyoh kutubxonani qidiryapti. Odam unga yo‘lni tushuntiradi. Qayerdan burilish kerakligi, kutubxona nimaning yonida ekani va yo‘l qancha ketishiga e’tibor bering. Chap va o‘ng tomonni adashtirib qo‘ymang.
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the library? Go straight and turn left at the bank. The library is next to the post office, on the right. Is it far? No, it is five minutes on foot. Thank you very much.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, kutubxona qayerda? To‘g‘ri yuring va bankda chapga buriling. Kutubxona pochtaning yonida, o‘ng tomonda. Uzoqmi? Yo‘q, piyoda besh daqiqa. Katta rahmat.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: savollar
board: 2) What is the library next to?
3) Is it on the left or on the right?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: sayyoh qayerda chapga buriladi? Ikkinchi: kutubxona nimaning yonida? Uchinchi: u chap tomondami yoki o‘ng tomondami? To‘rtinchi: piyoda qancha vaqt ketadi? Qisqa va aniq javob bering.
scenes.say: One. Where does he turn left? Two. What is the library next to? Three. Is it on the left or on the right? Four. How long is it on foot?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. U qayerda chapga buriladi? Ikki. Kutubxona nimaning yonida? Uch. U chapdami yoki o‘ngdami? To‘rt. Piyoda qancha vaqt?

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bankda chapga buriladi: at the bank. Kutubxona pochtaning yonida: next to the post office. U o‘ng tomonda: on the right. Piyoda besh daqiqa: five minutes on foot. Tinglash qismida birinchi javobni topolmasangiz, to‘xtab qolmang. Keyingi savolga o‘ting, chunki dialog davom etadi.
scenes.say: At the bank. The post office. On the right. Five minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Bankda. Pochta. O‘ng tomonda. Besh daqiqa.

scenes.title: O‘qish qismi: strategiya
board: 1 Read the title and questions first
3 Underline the answer in the text
scenes.say_native: O‘qish qismi uchun to‘rtta maslahat. Avval sarlavhani va savollarni o‘qing, shunda nimani qidirishni bilasiz. Matndan ism, raqam va joy nomlarini toping. Javob joyini chizib qo‘ying. To‘g‘ri yoki noto‘g‘ri savollarida har bir so‘zga qarang: bitta so‘z o‘zgargan bo‘lsa, gap noto‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin. Har bir so‘zni tarjima qilish shart emas.
scenes.say: Read the questions first. Find names, numbers and places in the text.
scenes.say_uz: Avval savollarni o‘qing. Matndan ismlarni, raqamlarni va joylarni toping.

scenes.title: O‘qish matni
board: Hi! My name is Dilya. I am 24 and I am from Samarkand.
I live in Tashkent with my sister. She is a doctor.
On Saturday I go to the market by bus. I buy fruit and bread.
scenes.say_native: Mana matn. Dilya o‘zi haqida yozgan. Uni sekin o‘qing, diktor ham o‘qiydi. Keyin to‘rtta gap bo‘yicha to‘g‘ri yoki noto‘g‘ri deb javob berasiz. Raqamlar, shahar nomlari va kimligiga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Hi! My name is Dilya. I am twenty-four and I am from Samarkand. I live in Tashkent with my sister. She is a doctor. On Saturday I go to the market by bus. I buy fruit and bread. I don't work on Sunday.
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Mening ismim Dilya. Men yigirma to‘rt yoshdaman va Samarqanddanman. Men Toshkentda singlim bilan yashayman. U shifokor. Shanba kuni bozorga avtobusda boraman. Meva va non sotib olaman. Yakshanba kuni ishlamayman.

scenes.title: O‘qish: True yoki False
board: 4) She goes to the market by bus.
scenes.say_native: Matn bo‘yicha true yoki false deb ayting. Birinchi: Dilya Toshkentdan. Ikkinchi: u singlisi bilan yashaydi. Uchinchi: uning singlisi talaba. To‘rtinchi: u bozorga avtobusda boradi. Har biri uchun to‘g‘ri gapni ham ayting.
scenes.say: True or false? One. Dilya is from Tashkent. Two. She lives with her sister. Three. Her sister is a student. Four. She goes to the market by bus.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘rimi yoki noto‘g‘rimi? Bir. Dilya Toshkentdan. Ikki. U singlisi bilan yashaydi. Uch. Singlisi talaba. To‘rt. U bozorga avtobusda boradi.

scenes.title: O‘qish: javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — false, u Samarqanddan, Toshkentda esa yashaydi. Ikkinchi — true. Uchinchi — false, singlisi shifokor. To‘rtinchi — true. Birinchi savol aldamchi: Toshkent matnda bor, lekin boshqa ma’noda. Shuning uchun so‘zni ko‘rib to‘xtamang, gapning to‘liq ma’nosini tekshiring.
scenes.say: False. True. False. True.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘ri. Noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Yozish qismi
scenes.say_native: Yozish qismida odatda o‘zingiz haqingizda qisqa matn yoki xat so‘raladi, taxminan qirq-ellik so‘z. Reja: ism, yosh, shahar, oila, kasb, kun tartibi, sevimli mashg‘ulot. Gaplarni and yoki but bilan bog‘lang. Bosh harf va nuqtani unutmang. Yozib bo‘lgach, to be, fe’ldagi s, a yoki an va ko‘plik shakllarini tekshiring. Tez, oddiy va xatosiz yozish uzun, ammo xato bilan yozishdan yaxshi.
scenes.say: Write about yourself in forty to fifty words. Use capital letters and full stops.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingiz haqingizda qirq-ellik so‘z yozing. Bosh harf va nuqta ishlating.

scenes.title: Yozish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Hozir yozing. Besh gap: ismingiz, yoshingiz, shahringiz, oilangiz va sevimli mashg‘ulotingiz. Masalan, My name is... I am... I live in... Daftarga yozing va yigirma soniya ichida bajarishga harakat qiling. Yozib bo‘lgach, o‘zingiz tekshirasiz.
scenes.say: Write five sentences about yourself. Name, age, city, family, hobby.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingiz haqingizda besh gap yozing. Ism, yosh, shahar, oila, sevimli mashg‘ulot.

scenes.title: Yozish: namuna va tekshiruv
board: My name is Aziz. I am 22 years old.
I live in Bukhara. I have a small family.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: My name is Aziz. I am twenty-two years old. I live in Bukhara with my parents. I have a brother and a sister. I like football and music. Endi o‘zingiznikini tekshiring: har bir gap bosh harf bilan boshlanib, nuqta bilan tugadimi? I harfi doim katta. Yoshda am ishlatdingizmi? Have twenty years yozmadingizmi?
scenes.say: My name is Aziz. I am twenty-two. I live in Bukhara. I like football and music.
scenes.say_uz: Mening ismim Aziz. Men yigirma ikki yoshdaman. Buxoroda yashayman. Futbol va musiqani yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: -s oxiri
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. Fe’l oxiridagi s uch xil eshitiladi. Works — oxirida “s”, chunki oldin jarangsiz k bor. Plays — “z”, jarangli tovushdan keyin. Watches — “iz”, chunki ch dan keyin alohida bo‘g‘in kerak. Yana th tovushi: think — tilni tishlar orasiga qo‘yib, jarangsiz; this — shu joyda jarangli. Bu tovushlar o‘zbek tilida yo‘q, shuning uchun alohida mashq kerak.
scenes.say: Works. Plays. Watches. Think. This.
scenes.say_uz: Works. Plays. Watches. Think. This.

scenes.title: Talaffuz mashqi
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Works, plays, watches. Har birida oxirgi tovushni toza ayting. Keyin think, this, three, mother. Tilning uchi tishlar orasida bo‘lishi kerak. Think va three — jarangsiz, this va mother — jarangli. Ko‘zguda o‘zingizni kuzating.
scenes.say: Works, plays, watches. Think, this, three, mother.
scenes.say_uz: Works, plays, watches. Think, this, three, mother.

scenes.title: Gapirish qismi: o‘zingizni tanishtirish
scenes.say_native: Gapirish qismida odatda o‘zingiz haqingizda bir daqiqa gapirasiz. Tuzilma: ism, yosh va shahar. Keyin oila va kasb yoki o‘qish. Keyin sevimli mashg‘ulot va kun tartibi. Oxirida minnatdorchilik bilan yakunlang. Uzoq to‘xtab qolmang: agar so‘z esingizdan chiqsa, boshqa oddiy so‘z bilan ayting. Xatosiz kam gap emas, ravon va tushunarli gap muhim.
scenes.say: Name, age, city. Family and work. Hobby. Thank you!
scenes.say_uz: Ism, yosh, shahar. Oila va ish. Sevimli mashg‘ulot. Rahmat!

scenes.title: Gapirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Endi gapiring. O‘zingizni yigirma soniya davomida tanishtiring. Ismingiz, yoshingiz, shahringiz, oilangiz va sevimli mashg‘ulotingiz haqida ayting. Xato qilsangiz to‘xtamang, davom eting. Imtihonda ham shunday bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Introduce yourself for twenty seconds. Say your name, age, city and hobby.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingizni yigirma soniya tanishtiring. Ismingiz, yoshingiz, shahringiz va sevimli mashg‘ulotingizni ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I live in Bukhara. I am a student.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: Hello! My name is Aziz. I am twenty-two years old. I am from Bukhara, but I live in Tashkent. I study English and I work in a shop. I have a brother and a sister. I like football and music. Thank you! Sizning javobingizda ham to be va hozirgi oddiy zamon bo‘lishi kerak. Bu gapirish qismida yaxshi baho beradi.
scenes.say: Hello! My name is Aziz. I live in Tashkent. I study English. I like football. Thank you!
scenes.say_uz: Salom! Mening ismim Aziz. Men Toshkentda yashayman. Men ingliz tilini o‘rganaman. Men futbolni yoqtiraman. Rahmat!

scenes.title: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan besh xato
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy ro‘yxat: o‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilar eng ko‘p qiladigan besh xato. Artikl yetishmasligi. She works dagi s ni unutish. Savolda tartib: Where do you live, “Where you live” emas. Yosh uchun am, have emas. Sondan keyin ko‘plik s. Imtihonda yozishdan oldin va gapirishdan oldin shu beshtani eslang.
scenes.say: Check these five things: articles, s, questions, am, plurals.
scenes.say_uz: Shu beshtasini tekshiring: artikl, s, savollar, am, ko‘plik.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
scenes.say_native: Tezkor mashq. Har bir gapdagi xatoni toping va to‘g‘ri aytib bering. Birinchi: she work in a shop. Ikkinchi: where you live. Uchinchi: I have twenty years. To‘rtinchi: I have two sister. Qoidani ham aytib bering, nega xato.
scenes.say: Correct the mistakes. One. She work in a shop. Two. Where you live? Three. I have twenty years. Four. I have two sister.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni to‘g‘rilang. Bir. She work in a shop. Ikki. Where you live? Uch. I have twenty years. To‘rt. I have two sister.

scenes.title: Xatolar javobi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: she works, uchinchi shaxsda s kerak. Ikkinchi: Where do you live, savolda do kerak. Uchinchi: I am twenty, yoshda am ishlatiladi. To‘rtinchi: two sisters, sondan keyin s. Hammasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, siz eng keng tarqalgan xatolarni o‘zingiz tuzata olasiz, bu juda katta yutuq.
scenes.say: She works. Where do you live? I am twenty. Two sisters.
scenes.say_uz: She works. Where do you live? I am twenty. Two sisters.

scenes.title: Daraja xulosasi
board: to be, Present Simple, can, there is/are
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Grammatikada: to be, hozirgi oddiy zamon, can, there is va there are, artikllar va ko‘plik. Lug‘atda: oila, ovqat, shahar, vaqt, kunlar. Muloqotda: tanishuv, do‘kon, yo‘l ko‘rsatish. Imtihon uchun to‘rt qoida: topshiriqni o‘qing, oson savoldan boshlang, bo‘sh qoldirmang, tekshiring. Siz buning hammasini qila olasiz.
scenes.say: You can introduce yourself, shop, ask for directions and write simple sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Siz o‘zingizni tanishtira olasiz, xarid qila olasiz, yo‘l so‘ray olasiz va oddiy gaplar yoza olasiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Next lesson: Past Simple — regular verbs
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: A1 imtihonini to‘liq yeching. Keyin o‘zingizni bir daqiqa davomida tanishtirishni telefoningizga yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni — testda o‘n beshtadan kamida o‘n ikkitasi to‘g‘ri va yozuvda to be hamda hozirgi zamon xatosiz ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda o‘tgan zamonni, ya’ni muntazam fe’llarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: do the A1 exam and record a one-minute introduction. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: A1 imtihonini yeching va bir daqiqalik tanishtiruvni yozib oling. Omad!

homework_uz: A1 imtihonini to‘liq yeching va o‘zingizni 1 daqiqa tanishtirishni telefonga yozib oling. Mezon: testda 15 tadan kamida 12 tasi to‘g‘ri, yozuvda am/is/are va fe’lga -s xatosiz ishlatilgan.

quiz.why_uz: Yosh to be bilan aytiladi: I am twenty-five. “I have 25 years” — o‘zbekchadan olingan xato.
To be bilan savol: Are you from...? Bunday gapda do ishlatilmaydi.
He, she, it bilan hozirgi oddiy zamonda fe’lga s qo‘shiladi: she works.
He bilan savolda does ishlatiladi: Does he speak English?
Doesn’t dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda keladi: doesn’t drink.
Can dan keyin to qo‘yilmaydi va fe’lga s qo‘shilmaydi: I can speak.
Apple unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun an apple.

quiz.q: There ___ three books on the table.
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘plikda there are ishlatiladi: There are three books.

quiz.q: Which word is a family word?
quiz.why_uz: Sister — oila a’zosi. Bank — joy, bread — ovqat, Monday — hafta kuni.
Savolda do kerak va tartib: savol so‘zi + do + ega + fe’l.

quiz.q: “Can I pay by card?” You ask this in a ___.
quiz.why_uz: To‘lov usuli haqidagi savol do‘konda yoki kassada beriladi: Can I pay by card?

quiz.q: “Turn left at the bank.” This sentence gives ___.
quiz.why_uz: Turn left — yo‘nalish berish, ya’ni directions.

quiz.q: Dilya lives with her sister. What does her sister do? (Dilya: “She is a doctor.”)
quiz.why_uz: Matnda: She is a doctor. Savolga javob matndan topiladi.

quiz.q: Which word has the ending sound /ɪz/?
quiz.why_uz: Watches oxirida alohida bo‘g‘in /ɪz/ bor. Works — /s/, plays — /z/.

quiz.q: Which is the best exam strategy?
quiz.why_uz: Topshiriqni avval o‘qish noto‘g‘ri tushunishdan saqlaydi. Bo‘sh qoldirish va tekshirmaslik ball yo‘qotadi.
